title: Defining and Evaluating Fair Natural Language Generation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything in terms of faith or religion. It focused exclusively on evaluating gender bias in natural language generation models by analyzing professions generated from gendered prompts.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its analysis is entirely focused on gender bias.
